Gold default broken: LONG 9/19 (v4 15/18), SHORT 6, NEUTRAL 4. Gold now follows the conditional stance: LONG in 8 of 12 items with a negative real rate and 1 of 7 with a positive one. Judged justified by event and data in 9, data-driven and labelled so in 3, partly justified in 6, a default in 1 (syn-a0006).

Credit default broken: SHORT 9/19 (v4 15/18), LONG 6/19 for good news (GDP beat, truce, productivity, bank merger, YCC carry, China stimulus), NEUTRAL 4/19. Of the 9 SHORTs: 2 justified (vacancy collapse, interbank stress), 3 partly, 4 defaults (lithium closure, RBA hike, 5% duty, frontier lean at conviction 1).
Minority-scenario rule mostly applied: calls on scenarios below 0.4 get conviction 1 or NEUTRAL, with the threshold stated (gold NEUTRAL in syn-a0002, syn-a0012), and S1-only reasoning is gone.

Diagnosis widened: the real policy rate is compared with trend growth and money growth in 19/19 and now discriminates (credit judged not artificially cheap in 7/19). Most items refuse to impute a past boom ('I will not impute one').

Foreign events: 7 of 8 name the missing foreign variables and refuse to judge that economy with US data (BoE, RBA, China stimulus, BoJ twice, EM peg, frontier). The v4 errors of a US real rate judging the BoE or RBA are gone.

Tool honesty holds: no value or episode beyond the tool results, 15/19 request the full backdrop, and every oil call has WTI fetched. Pre-event levels are explicitly not read as effects in 13/19, and real-rate arithmetic is right in 18/19.

Good news handled: the payroll beat's modal case is now 'strength forces normalisation' with gold SHORT. Truce, productivity and bank merger get equities or credit LONG. 5/19 modal probabilities are 0.55-0.62, and one item says 'Confidence: low'.
remaining_problems: Calibration still templated. 'Confidence: moderate' in 18/19, even where the weakest-link line meets the prompt's own 'low' definition (syn-a0002, a0012, a0017). Modal at 0.40-0.50 in 13/19 (v4 15/18) and S1 = 0.45 in 10/19 (v4 7/18), including contained events the prompt allows 0.6-0.85 (China 150bn, RBA, YCC). Five exact tuples are shared by 10/19 items, including the v1 tuple 0.45/0.30/0.15/0.10 twice.

New echoes replace the old ones. A no-contradiction sentence ('the event states no level the data contradict', 'nothing to arbitrate', 'no conflict to resolve') in 7/19. Pre-event disclaimers in 13/19. 'Already annualised' or 'no annualisation needed' in 4/19, 'I rely on' in 4/19, profile quotes as 'my rule' in 2/19. School self-reference survives as 'the Austrian question', 'for an Austrian' or 'in Austrian terms' in 6/19 (the ECHO regex misses these), and 'in my framework' appears in 9/19.

New stock diagnosis. Real policy rate vs the 4-quarter average plus M2 now vs a year earlier opens all 19 items. The 4-quarter average is taken as the natural rate even when negative (-1.0%, -0.4%). The money test is applied one way: M2 at 9-11% is dismissed when the rate looks expensive (syn-a0015, a0017), while flat or slow M2 does not stop a malinvestment claim when the rate looks cheap (syn-a0000, a0002, a0006).

'Necessary liquidation' is the new stock mechanism: it is an L3 step in 15/19, and 4 items invoke it right after finding no boom (syn-a0008, a0010, a0012, a0018: 'no boom to liquidate', then 'liquidation of existing malinvestment'). 'Malinvestment' is also applied to supply-shock losses (syn-a0004).

Signal support is massaged. Seven items count flat or 'contained' scenarios to clear the 0.4 threshold (syn-a0010, a0011, a0013, a0014, a0017, a0018, a0019), and three cite scenarios whose tags point the other way (gold in a0006 and a0011, bonds in a0009). The data-driven clause became a loophole: small or remote events keep directional calls (syn-a0016: four calls for a 5% duty; syn-a0008: five calls for an RBA hike), and pre-event levels serve as reasons (VIX/HY in a0006, a0012, a0013; DXY 110 in a0004).

New directional tilts: USD LONG 12/19 (unjustified for the lithium closure, the RBA hike and the frontier economy) and equities SHORT 10/19 (5 for good news or small or remote events: payroll beat, GDP beat, lithium closure, RBA, 5% duty).
Format: 7/19 have two scenarios with identical growth/inflation tags (the prompt asks for different directions), and 4/19 proofs run to 8 lines (teacher.py passes max_steps=10).

Template-level failures persist from v4. BoJ YCC: EP-2016-09 taken as the event and used to set the peg level, and bonds SHORT against its own carry chain. RBA: DXY LONG on a hawkish foreign hike. Chinese default: the US real rate and M2 explain Chinese malinvestment, and credit goes SHORT under a 'contained' S1. Lithium duty: equities and credit SHORT for a narrow measure.

Economic and factual slips. A steep curve read as late cycle (syn-a0013, a0016), and an inverted curve as a maturity-mismatch signature (a0011). The 2007 and 1998 injections placed in a 'near-zero real rate regime', with a high real rate said to limit easing room (a0011). 'Three points below trend' for six (a0009). EP-2020-07's base effect applied to a 0.4% quarter (a0006). Disinflation said to lower real rates at a 0.125% policy rate (a0013). USDC counted as a bank (a0017). EP-2022-09-23 recast as yield defence (a0014), EP-2014-12's causality reversed (a0015), and a frontier currency said to lift DXY (a0019).
suggested_prompt_or_template_changes: Confidence and modal band: v6's Evidence label (already committed) targets this, but the v6 pilot log reports labels 'mostly mixed', so check that 'mixed' is not the new 'moderate'. Tie the labels to observable tests: decisive when the data and at least two fitting episodes agree on the modal path; weak when the weakest link is an unobserved variable separating the top two scenarios, or at most one episode fits. Reject a batch where one label exceeds 60%.

Probabilities: reject an exact tuple used twice in a batch and a modal of exactly 0.45 in more than a fifth of it. When the first [Think] sizes the event as small or contained, require a base case of at least 0.6.
Validator: reject scenarios with identical growth/inflation tags, and enforce the 4-7 proof lines the prompt states (max_steps=7 instead of 10).

Signal reasons: write 'for: S1+S2 (0.xx); against: S3 (0.xx)'. Check in code that every 'for' scenario's tags imply the call's direction, so a flat/flat or contained scenario never counts, and that 'for' is at least 0.4 for conviction 2 or more.

Close the data loophole: for a small or remote event every signal is NEUTRAL, and a view from the backdrop alone goes in one 'Backdrop:' sentence, not in the signals. Add that a pre-event level (VIX, spread, DXY) is a starting point, not a reason for a direction.

Echoes: show the contradiction rule only when align_backdrop imposed a level, and the annualisation rule only when the event states a monthly figure. Add to ECHO: 'nothing to arbitrate|no conflict to resolve|states no level', 'already annuali[sz]ed|no annuali[sz]ation', 'predate the event|not (the|this) event's effect', 'I rely on', 'my rule', 'Austrian question|for an Austrian|in Austrian terms', 'in my framework'.

Natural rate: add a long trend series (10-year average real growth or potential growth), and say that a negative 4-quarter average marks a recession, not a negative natural rate. Have the first [Think] name the event's own mechanism, and use the rate/money test only where credit conditions matter.

Austrian profile additions: 'a necessary liquidation presupposes a boom the data show; a contraction without one is a deflationary shock'; 'malinvestment means investment induced by credit below the natural rate, not a loss from a supply shock'; 'money growth far above nominal GDP counts as money creation even at a high policy rate'; 'a steep curve marks early recovery and an inverted one late cycle; the curve does not measure maturity mismatch'.

Episode table: drop EP-2016-09 from the BoJ YCC results, or append 'the event is later than every episode listed' to every query_episode_db result. Rewrite EP-2022-09-23 to say the BoE purchases were temporary and the reversed measures were fiscal. Add a reserve-backed stablecoin run without a rescue.

Asset referents: add 'DXY holds EUR, JPY, GBP, CAD, SEK and CHF only; AUD, EM and frontier currencies reach it only through risk-off', and warn when USD LONG exceeds 60% of a school's batch (12/19 here).

Before training on v5: drop or regenerate syn-a0014 (an episode taken as the event) and syn-a0013 (US data used for a Chinese diagnosis). Use syn-a0006 and syn-a0011 only after their gold, curve and regime claims are fixed.
